findings.text: Entering a preemptible read section raises the calling task nesting count and, on strict grace builds where a grace thread exists, arms a request for a near term quiescent state, with proving builds additionally checking that depth stays below a very large ceiling.

Leaving a preemptible read section lowers the nesting count and, only when the outermost section closes, consults a per task special word and invokes deferred handling when that word is set, with proving builds validating that depth remains within sane bounds.
Nesting manipulation is centralized in tiny helpers that respectively add one, subtract one and return the new value, or assign an explicit value to the per task nesting counter.
The nesting sanity ceiling is defined as one half of the largest signed integer value.

Outermost unlock with pending special work returns immediately inside non maskable context, otherwise it inspects whether preemption, bottom halves or interrupts were disabled and, when any were, postpones quiescent reporting through either soft interrupt raising or a reschedule request plus optional irq work, falling through to immediate deferred reporting only when fully enabled.

The need for expedited treatment is a heuristic that becomes true when the task has a blocked node with expedited waiters, when the local cpu mask overlaps the node expedited mask, on strict builds when a normal quiescent bit is still pending or the task is blocked, or on boosting builds when interrupts were disabled while blocked.

Deferred quiescent irq work that happens to execute while a new read section is active must not be treated as complete, so it clears its pending marker to force a later requeue and avoid lost wakeups.

Task exit cleanup has two build variants, one empty and one that, when the exiting task sits on a blocked list or still shows nesting, forces a single level of nesting with the blocked flag set as needed and then performs a normal outermost unlock plus deferred quiescent processing.

Strict mode unlock reporting is skipped while interrupts are disabled, while atomic with preemption off, or without a grace thread, otherwise it clears the local normal quiescent need, reports a quiescent state for this cpu, and then briefly delays.

The urgent quiescent entry first tests a per cpu urgent flag with fast and ordered checks under disabled preemption, and when set it clears the flag, optionally enters a momentary extended quiescent period when a heavy flag is set, and then reports a quiescent state.

The context switch hook always reports a quiescent state, then drains the urgent flag with an ordered load and handles the heavy flag with a momentary extended period before notifying the tasks flavor about the switch.
Per cpu thread setup records the target cpu control block, optionally raises the thread to first in first out realtime priority when boosting is configured, and stamps an activity timestamp.

Priority boosting selects a target list and task while holding the node lock with interrupts saved, revalidates emptiness under the lock, installs a proxy lock tied to the chosen task, and only then releases the lock so the task cannot disappear mid boost.

Boosting prefers tasks blocking expedited grace periods over those blocking only normal periods, manufacturing a locked proxy mutex owned by the chosen task and then briefly acquiring it to raise priority, while counting each boost and reporting whether more work remains.

The per node boost thread cycles among waiting, running and yielding states, waiting for either task list to become non empty, performing a boost pass, and voluntarily sleeping briefly after many consecutive passes that still leave work.
The boost start delay converts a millisecond configuration value into jiffies with round up division by one thousand scaled by the tick rate.
The current task boosted query disables preemption to stabilize the blocked node pointer, reports false when there is no node, otherwise compares the node boost mutex owner against the current task.

Stall control exposes two kernel sysctls, one boolean panic on stall switch bounded between zero and one and one maximum stall count before panic bounded below by one, registered under the kernel directory at init.
A read only sysfs attribute reports an unsigned stall counter as decimal text, created in the kernel object group at init.

Stall delay compensation has two build variants, one adding five seconds worth of ticks and one adding nothing, while the stall warning threshold divides a base interval by eight with a floor of two seconds worth of ticks.
Sysrq stall suppression uses a small state where start sets the suppress flag to two when clear and end clears it back to zero only from that same value, leaving panic induced suppression untouched.
A panic notifier forces stall suppression on and returns handled, with its block registered on the panic chain at init.
Stall detection reset shortens the force quiescent jiffies allowance to a count of three and pushes the next stall deadline to the largest representable time value.

Stall irq work locates its per cpu control and parent node from the work item, then under the node lock snapshots the current grace sequence into the per cpu slot and clears the pending flag, warning if no work was pending.
The stall diagnostic snapshot for a reader carries an integer nesting level, a copy of the special unlock union, and a boolean telling whether the task sits on a blocked list.
Slow task inspection declines to examine a currently running task with a busy error, otherwise it copies nesting, special state and blocked list membership into the supplied snapshot.
Grace period states have a table mapping nine lifecycle values from idle through waiting, done, onoff, init, wait fqs, doing fqs, cleanup and cleaned to matching name strings.
Two file local booleans gate cross subsystem stall suppression and sysrq dump enablement.

Boost failure diagnosis walks every leaf node, treating any remaining quiescent mask as proof that cpus are still responsible, otherwise recording whether any node still holds grace blocked tasks to blame boosting, with an optional output for the first holdout cpu found under lock.
The sysrq debug key handler shows grace threads, described by a key operation tied to help and action strings and a dump enable mask, registered for key y at init only when the enable flag is set.
Tracing is enabled by defining a creation marker and module parameters are namespaced under the name rcupdate with a trailing dot.
Two nesting counters for asynchronous hurry and expedited handling are atomic integers each starting at one to reflect boot time state.
A mostly read flag records whether the in kernel boot phase has ended.
End of in kernel boot relaxes both expedited and asynchronous hurry nesting, optionally switches to normal grace handling when configured to do so after boot, and then marks boot as ended.
Runtime mode initialization exercises synchronization primitives, marks the scheduler as running, notifies the reclaim path that the scheduler runs, and exercises the primitives again.

Three lockdep maps distinguish normal, bottom half and scheduler read lock flavors with distinct names and with outer free wait type, where normal and bottom half use config wait inner type and scheduler uses spin wait inner type.
Callback execution has its own lockdep map with a dedicated key and a callback oriented name.
Held queries first consult a common helper and otherwise fall back to lockdep state, with the any flavor also accepting bottom half or scheduler holdings and treating non preemptible context as held.
The generic wait callback recovers its enclosing synchronization record from the callback head and completes it.

Waiting for several grace flavors registers at most one stack callback per distinct queue function after deduplication, optionally skipping the tiny synchronous case with a sleep check, then blocks for each distinct completion and destroys the stack object.
Finishing a wait clears the waiter task pointer and marks the current task runnable.
Callback heads have debug object init and free helpers tied to a descriptor named for the head type whose static object check always succeeds.

Trivial preempt synchronization orders prior accesses, holds a read section while scanning every thread, skips the caller to avoid self deadlock, and spins on each other thread trivial nesting with acquire ordering.
Two mostly read integers control optional stall notifier production and ftrace dumping on stalls.
